_doc: Daily-close tail for the V2 hubs. c = adjusted closes (dividends+splits) aligned to `calendar` (SPY sessions, oldest first, null = no print that day); l = RAW intraday lows for the last 130 sessions (calendar[-130:]); adv20_usd = 20-session mean of close*volume; worst_dd_3y / med_mdd252_3y = the two slow backtest features computed from the full 12y download (n_full sessions); tvw = Gavin's weekly TradingView v20/v22 signals on completed weekly bars (relay/tv_weekly.py; see tvw_meta). Built by relay/fetch_tail.py.

tvw_meta.rule: BUY = v20 or v22 botFire on a completed weekly bar; buy_ago = completed weeks since; top5 = first week of topScore>=5 with the top regime
